chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
Whenever two people accompany one another, the one with the greater reward and the one more beloved to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, is the one who is gentler toward his companion.

key_terms.أَحَبُّهُمَا: the more beloved of the two
key_terms.أَرْفَقَهُمَا: the gentler and more considerate of the two
key_terms.أَعْظَمُهُمَا: the greater of the two in rank or reward
key_terms.اصْطَحَبَ: accompanied or kept company with one another

ai.seo_question: Who is more beloved to Allah when two people travel or accompany one another?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that excellence in companionship is measured by gentleness, care, and consideration toward one’s companion. Greater reward and nearness to Allah are attached to better conduct in social relations.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2437 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said:
"Whenever two people accompany each other, the one with the greater reward and who is more beloved to Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious, is the one who is more considerate toward their companion."
